title: THE CHOCOLATE ROOM
description: Beyond chocolate, a whole new world opened up.

panel-001.alt: Cover artwork for THE CHOCOLATE ROOM.

captions.text:
Beyond chocolate,
a whole new world opened up.

panel-002.alt: HOGIRL works in a hotel VIP lounge in Myeong-dong.

captions.text:
Before that door opened,
I was working in the VIP lounge
of a five-star hotel in Myeong-dong.

panel-003.alt: Hotel staff prepare a new experience for their guests.

captions.text:
This luxurious hotel was always creating
new experiences for its guests.

panel-004.alt: HOGIRL discovers a boutique filled with chocolates.

captions.text:
A boutique filled with chocolates
from around the world!

Oh, chocolate.
I miss my mom.

panel-005.alt: HOGIRL remembers sharing chocolate with her mother.

captions.text:
There was always chocolate
in my mom’s grocery bag.

It brings back memories
of sharing chocolate with my mom
when I was little.

panel-006.alt: HOGIRL looks at unfamiliar chocolate creations.

captions.text:
But this wasn’t
the chocolate I knew.

All of this…
is chocolate?

panel-007.alt: A three-tier cake is decorated with white roses.

captions.text: It looked like a work of art.
It didn’t just look like art. It was art.

There were chocolate
sculptures—and even
chocolate fashion shows.

panel-010.alt: HOGIRL asks a colleague where she can study chocolate.

captions.text:
Is there anywhere in Korea
where I can actually learn this?

K Culinary Arts School
offers a chocolate course.
There, I trained from the basics to advanced techniques.

I even earned
a professional chocolatier certification.

panel-012.alt: HOGIRL makes a chocolate creation with her own hands.

captions.text:
The world that had once been
beyond the glass
was now in my hands.

I attended a seminar
by a Belgian chocolatier.

It was the same chocolate, but something felt different.
I could feel years of experience in his hands—
and a culture that had become second nature.

panel-014.alt: A cacao tree and its fruit.

captions.text:
Chocolate starts on a tree?
Cacao beans are fermented and roasted?
So I went to Malaysia.

panel-016.alt: HOGIRL explores cacao fruit, fermentation and roasting.

captions.text:
I opened a freshly picked cacao pod,
tasted the pulp,
and watched the beans
being fermented and roasted.

panel-017.alt: A chocolatier creates art with chocolate.

captions.text:
CHOCOLATIERS—
the people who turn chocolate into art.

panel-018.alt: HOGIRL is absorbed in the world of chocolate.

captions.text:
That was it.
I was completely hooked.

panel-019.alt: HOGIRL decides to study chocolate seriously.

captions.text:
This is crazy.
I’m going all the way with this.

panel-020.alt: HOGIRL researches culinary schools around the world.

captions.text:
So where do I go next?
I started looking at culinary schools around the world.

panel-021.alt: The Statue of Liberty and an American flag accompany HOGIRL’s decision.

captions.text:
America?
CIA?
Okay.
NEXT — AMERICA SAID NO
